item.description:
## Settings - The window runs on macOS's own chrome: toolbar panes, grouped forms, and your system accent in place of the crimson tint. - The theme picker is a grid of popup sketches, so Sky and Ocean no longer read as the same blue rectangle. Picking a theme opens the popup so you see the change. - Menu bar drops its preview strip, and every pane sizes the window to its own content. - Sentence case throughout, no all-caps labels, no icons in tinted circles. - General lists the mobile app: iPhone and Android are on the way.
## Navigation - `आज` moved into the header, between the month arrows. (suggested by Yuyutsu Poudel) - One trackpad swipe moves one month instead of three. (reported by Yuyutsu Poudel) - The popup opens on the current month every time. (reported by Yuyutsu Poudel)
## Fixes - System calendars load as soon as you grant access, with no trip to Refresh Calendars. - Edits in Calendar.app refresh the month you are looking at. - A delete that macOS refuses now says so instead of leaving the event in the list. - Widgets show holidays added after the release. Each one used to read an event cache that its sandbox never held. - Event sync retries instead of failing in silence.
## Polish - The Convert button has stronger contrast and lights up on hover. - The installer window carries a new calendar-leaf background with a crimson नेपाली पात्रो header. - The supporter link opens the license page instead of dropping you into checkout.

## Appearance - The System, Light, and Dark themes now all use the native macOS menu material, so the popover matches other menu-bar apps in every mode. The Dark theme drops its old flat gradient for the same frosted look, just pinned to dark. - Added 'Add Events' on Calendar tab. - Redesigned Events & Calendar section. ## Calendar Data Fixes - Aasoj 2083 now shows 31 days instead of 30. Mangsir, Poush, and Magh 2083 were wrong by a day each in a way that cancelled out, so only Aasoj looked off; all four are corrected. - Fixed Chaitra in 2095, 2096, and 2097. Chaitra 2096 was two days short, leaving that year with 364 days.

## Appearance - The System and Light themes now use the native macOS menu material, so the popover matches other menu-bar apps. Dark mode no longer looks washed-out gray.
## Calendar Data Fixes - Aasoj 2083 now shows 31 days instead of 30. Mangsir, Poush, and Magh 2083 were wrong by a day each in a way that cancelled out, so only Aasoj looked off; all four are corrected. - Fixed Chaitra in 2095, 2096, and 2097. Chaitra 2096 was two days short, leaving that year with 364 days.

## What's New
- **Desktop Widgets** — Nepali date and calendar widgets on your desktop (small & medium) - **Event Countdown** — Widgets show days remaining for upcoming events - **Collapsible Event Indicators** — Toggle event/holiday dots on the calendar - **Sky Theme** — New Sky color scheme with gradient backgrounds

• Desktop widgets for Nepali date and calendar
  • Collapsible event and holiday indicators
  • New Sky color scheme with gradient backgrounds

• Faster date conversion and calendar rendering
  • Copy Nepali or English date from tooltip
